auditPolicy.ciBehavior: The raw audit runs as its own security-audit job in CI so a functional regression and the known security-policy gate are separately attributable. That job still fails, so the workflow reports red.
auditPolicy.futureTask: A controlled mechanism distinguishing reviewed temporary exceptions from new vulnerabilities, without hiding the raw audit result. Still not built.

knownIssues: Raw audit still fails on the two unresolved Stage 0 advisories (node-forge, braces); the CI workflow reports red because of it.

Two scoped dependency overrides remain ahead of Prisma's upstream exact pins ('@prisma/config>deepmerge-ts': 8.0.2 and 'prisma>mysql2': 3.24.5); drop each once its parent ships an already-patched pin.
DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL are now required infrastructure configuration; any script or CI job omitting them fails fast.
Hosted Linux GitHub Actions failed at 635536b because Turbo filtered the test URLs; local repair validation is recorded in tasks/CURRENT.md. Hosted re-run required after owner push.
Native Android/iOS device and store builds have not run.
Integration testing has so far been performed on Windows with Docker Desktop; Linux-container behaviour and non-amd64 images were not exercised.
The Compose PostgreSQL image is pinned to the PostgreSQL major through the available pgvector/pgvector:0.8.7-pg17 tag rather than to a patch release.
Redis AOF is disabled in local development; revisit with any stage that needs Redis durability.
Local Compose PostgreSQL credentials and privileges are development-only and must never be copied to staging or production.
No controlled security-audit exception mechanism exists yet; deferred to a future security-policy task.

InfrastructureProbe is temporary infrastructure scaffolding and should be replaced or removed when genuine domain schema arrives, using a new forward migration rather than by rewriting accepted migration history.
pnpm mobile:check and pnpm mobile:export were re-validated at closure and pass; the exported bundle hash is identical to Stage 0.
ESLint 9.39.5 is upstream-deprecated and retained for peer compatibility with the React lint chain.
checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, and pnpm/action-setup@v4 declare node20; GitHub runs actions on Node 24. Action upgrades deferred to a separately validated follow-up.
ubuntu-latest migrates from 24.04 to 26.04 during October 19-November 19, 2026; validate the new image as follow-up.

nextAction: Owner reviews, commits, pushes, and observes the new hosted GitHub Actions run. Validate should pass; raw security-audit remains failing on the two-high baseline. Do not start Stage 2.

postAcceptanceCIRepair.rootCause: Workflow test URLs were valid and available to migration outside Turbo. Turbo default strict environment filtering removed TEST_DATABASE_URL and TEST_REDIS_URL from integration task processes because neither was declared. Local .env reload masked the defect.
postAcceptanceCIRepair.reproducedBeforeEditing: With .env absent and explicit workflow URLs, test migration succeeded, then Redis Vitest setup failed with the identical missing-key error; 8 tests skipped and Turbo stopped.
postAcceptanceCIRepair.fix: turbo.json tasks.test:integration.env explicitly lists TEST_DATABASE_URL and TEST_REDIS_URL
unchanged: CI workflow and raw audit command
postAcceptanceCIRepair.environment: Windows, Node 24.16.0, pnpm 12.3.4, TSMS Compose services; explicit workflow URLs, .env temporarily hidden, TURBO_FORCE=true
